title: DNA: Season 2 | Episode 3
description:
Close in on Vengeance...

Continue DNA in Season 2 Episode 3 following the journey of Leo as he arrives in Nova Wasteland on his path to Nova Corp to confront Terius.

Enter the Nova Wastelands...
• Move through the unforgiving Nova Wasteland as Leo continues his search for Terius.

• Play through rewarding challenges fueled by vengeance.

• Fight against the evil Nova Corp army as you traverse through Nova Wasteland...

End Your Vengeance...
• Pick back up this season with DNA's epic 2D Beat'em up gameplay with new abilities to acquire!

• Experience a challenging gameplay formula building upon last season's rewarding difficulties.

• Battle fearsome Nova Corp enemies as you fight through Nova Wasteland. 

Find Your Nemesis.
• Watch as the story develops further into intriguing events in Season 2: Episode 3 of DNA.

• Search for the cold hearted Terius, in a challenging level of intense difficulty and grit.

• Fight through the desolate Nova Wasteland as Leo battles against Nova Corp troops and highly advanced powerful Nova mechs in order to reach Nova Corp ...
description_short: DNA 1 is a hand drawn episodic beat up up anime game created by a Solo Developer. Play as the protagonist Leo, a genetically modified with Extraterrestrial life Elite Nova Corp Troop, as he faces challenges on what path he must take to change his life. Thus begins the epic story of DNA!
